system.description: The Stormkelt summons an armor of massive storm flurries that swirl around the dimwalker or a chosen character. The armor provides a Protection Value of 4 against melee weapons and a Protection Value of 6 against ranged weapons. Against magical weapons, the Protection Value is 3 against melee weapons and 5 against ranged weapons.
